description: Reference clean single-page application. No known vulnerabilities. Used to catch false positives from probes that misfire on modern SPAs (SPA XHR seeding, DOM XSS, clickjacking on client-rendered shells).

safeEndpoints.note: SPA shell has no server-side reflection
CSP is present and strict; no report expected
CORS is intentionally permissive on health only; must not be flagged as vulnerable
